summary: Rebuilt the root frontend as a fresh Next.js App Router command center with local prompt parsing, structured setup, URL-backed state, worksheet preview, trust/export panels, mobile workflow, and preserved JSON-first worksheet generation.

commands_run.notes: Passed with existing warnings for older manual result-state mismatches and ready-task path overlaps.
Validated 3 valid fixtures and 1 invalid fixture.
Frontend tests passed, including prompt parsing, URL state, filtering, generation, format switching, audit, answer checking, and make-another seed behavior.
Checked 139 worksheet types and 834 generated items.
Next webpack build passed; route / prerendered as static content.

acceptance_results.criterion: The root app is a fresh Next.js App Router command-center experience with prompt entry, structured setup, worksheet preview, trust panel, export actions, and mobile workflow
acceptance_results.notes: src/app/page.tsx now renders WorksheetCommandCenter with prompt entry, setup panel, preview, trust/export panel tabs, and mobile step tabs.

acceptance_results.criterion: The current console UI implementation is removed or replaced without changing the public Worksheet JSON schema
acceptance_results.notes: src/features/worksheet/TeacherConsole.tsx was deleted; src/types/worksheet.d.ts and schema files were not changed.

acceptance_results.criterion: A local parseWorksheetPrompt helper maps grade, topic/type, item count, format, and difficulty hints to existing deterministic worksheet generators without fabricating content
acceptance_results.notes: parseWorksheetPrompt maps prompt hints to existing worksheetTypes, strands, formats, grades, counts, and difficulty targets; tests cover fraction visual-model prompts and exact title detection.

acceptance_results.criterion: Stateful UI choices are reflected in URL query parameters and restored on load
acceptance_results.notes: intentFromSearchParams, intentToSearchParams, and normalizeIntent handle prompt, grade, strand, type, format, count, seed, difficulty, page size, and active panel; tests cover round-trip restoration.

acceptance_results.criterion: Preview, answer key, answer checking, print, JSON copy, and make-another behavior compile from canonical Worksheet JSON
acceptance_results.notes: WorksheetPreview, TrustPanel, checkAll, copyJson, print modes, and nextSeed behavior all consume generated Worksheet JSON and answerKey data.

acceptance_results.criterion: Changed UI follows the latest Vercel Web Interface Guidelines for labels, focus, semantic actions/navigation, live feedback, content handling, motion, and print/mobile layout
acceptance_results.notes: Fetched the latest guidelines, then audited changed UI/CSS for labels, aria-live feedback, focus-visible styles, labelled icon buttons, URL-backed state, reduced motion, touch behavior, print modes, and mobile safe-area layout.

acceptance_results.criterion: Frontend tests cover prompt parsing, filter mapping, deterministic generation, format switching, answer audit/checking, URL state helpers, and make-another seed behavior
acceptance_results.notes: tests/frontend/worksheet-console.test.ts now covers all listed helper and generation scenarios.

acceptance_results.criterion: Required validation, lint, typecheck, test, generator verification, and build commands pass

risks: No local Chromium/Playwright binary was available for screenshot automation.
The dev server required escalation and webpack mode because the sandbox blocked port binding and Turbopack hit the host file-watch limit.
